    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.1-0.3 too low compared to true outcomes, indicating systematic undershoot that corrects toward mean over the 30-day horizon",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.67-1.00) correlates with model undershoot, as model lags behind rapid sentiment shifts",
    "When sentiment turns negative (0.00-0.33), model forecasts overshoot slightly, reflecting delayed pessimism",
    "The gap between model and true outcomes narrows from ~0.2-0.3 early days to ~0.1-0.15 by day 15-20, showing mean-reversion correction in forecasts",
    "Model fails to capture sentiment-induced volatility spikes, particularly days 8-10 where true outcomes show 2-3% larger movements than forecasted",
    "When price history shows consolidation (low daily range), model underestimates the magnitude of sentiment-driven reversion movements",
    "Sentiment alignment with price direction breaks down during extreme moves; model follows sentiment but gets direction wrong during rapid reversals"
] }
